target_or_use: Ih (HCN) blocker for ex vivo sag/rebound/burst arms
source_facts: PMID22989944 (rat DRG): sodium-current IC50 1.17 uM against HCN-current IC50 15 uM; recombinant Nav1.4 almost abolished at 30 uM; calcium channels only at IC50 above 100 uM (cited). PMID33547341 (mouse hippocampal cultures, 50 uM): removes sag and rebound and reports no T-current block (Supplementary, not read). PMID34634460 cites a neocortical report: sag gone, Rin up, 4-AP events enhanced.
limits: DRG data are rat sensory neurons with 3-4 cells per concentration; cortical Nav isoforms untested; potency depends on protocol, exposure time and intracellular access; a cell-attached or single-cell internal application tests that cell only, not network block; a tool with poor brain penetration is still usable ex vivo and its poor penetration does not show the target is useless
not_to_conclude: Do not read a sag removal as proof that HCN carries the burst phenotype; do not read a burst change as HCN-specific without a second blocker and a sodium-current control; no dose or schedule here
